parameters.name: overturn_base_url
parameters.helpText: Your Overturn API URL when self-hosting. Set it in settings.json next to index.html, not in the plugin URL. https, or http://localhost.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.helpText: The workflow name. One regression suite per workflow.

parameters.name: reason_pack
parameters.helpText: Which one-click reasons teammates see: "support" or "claims".

parameters.name: require_reason
parameters.helpText: Hold a changed reply until the teammate picks a reason. On by default.

parameters.name: capture_internal_notes
parameters.helpText: Also capture an internal comment, not only a sent reply.

parameters.name: decision_fields
parameters.helpText: Custom fields that are the decision, as id:label pairs, e.g. fld_123:coverage, fld_456:reserve.

parameters.name: scope_tag
parameters.helpText: Optional. Only conversations carrying this tag are watched.

parameters.name: min_draft_chars
parameters.helpText: Text inserted into the composer in one go, at least this long, counts as the draft.
